subject: Request: POC grace period & temporary credits — API gateway migration
messages:
From: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@arcadiahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Jensen <mike.j@arcadiahealth.com>, Arcadia Health IT <it@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — delay on our side

Hi Marissa,

Quick update from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker in the API gateway migration that was scheduled for this week. The new gateway team just found a compatibility issue with our JWT header mapping; until that is remediated our engineering team can't finish the connector work.

We really want to proceed with Redwood — the evaluation is high priority for Q4 procurement — but this delay will push our ability to generate meaningful traffic by ~4-6 weeks.

Two asks:
- Would Redwood consider a 45-day extension on the trial window or a temporary allocation of sandbox credits so we can continue unit testing once the gateway patch lands?
- Any help your SE team can provide to review the migration plan would be appreciated (attaching the migration plan).

I've attached the migration plan and the POC statement of work. Happy to jump on a quick call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah Brooks
Product Manager, Integrations
Arcadia Health

[Attachment: gateway_migration_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: Arcadia_POC_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Mike Jensen <mike.j@arcadiahealth.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — delay on our side

On Tue, Sep 21, 2026 at 9:12 AM Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@arcadiahealth.com> wrote:
> Quick update from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker in the API gateway migration...

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the migration plan. Sorry to hear about the JWT mapping issue; that sounds like something our SE team can help validate quickly.

We can do two things immediately to keep momentum:
1) Provision a temporary sandbox credit pool (I can allocate an initial 150k token credit) so your engineers can continue internal tests as soon as the patch is applied.
2) Extend your trial window by 45 days from the current expiry date. If you prefer a longer runway, tell me and I can escalate.

If that works, I'll loop Diego (SE) on a short technical review call and copy in our manager for quick approval on the extra credits. Please propose a time for a 30-min sync today or tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

[Attachment: redwood_trial_terms.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@arcadiahealth.com>, Mike Jensen <mike.j@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood POC kickoff — delay on our side

Diego / Rishi — forwarding a short note from Arcadia. They have an API gateway migration that has introduced a JWT header mapping mismatch; they expect a 4–6 week delay to meaningful traffic.

My proposed response:
- Approve an immediate 150k token sandbox credit allocation for Arcadia so they can run tests post-patch.
- Apply a 45-day trial extension from their current end date.

Diego: can you confirm availability to do a 30-min call with their engineers and to do an architectural look at the migration plan? Ideally this week.
Rishi: can you confirm the credit allocation is fine from a commercial lens or whether you want to cap it differently?

Quick background: deal ARC-POC-1294, mid-market healthcare evaluation, strong product fit; procurement aims for a Nov decision.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Brooks <sarah.brooks@arcadiahealth.com>, Mike Jensen <mike.j@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood POC kickoff — delay on our side

Marissa / Rishi — I reviewed the migration plan (thanks Sarah) and this looks like a straightforward header mapping check plus a token exchange tweak. I can do a 30-min call tomorrow at 10:30am PT to walk their engineers through a live trace and show where our JWT parsing expects the 'x-auth-jwt' header.

Commercials: agreed on the 150k token sandbox credit as a temporary allocation. Recommend we gate any additional credits until we see test runs post-patch (we can re-evaluate after two successful test sessions). Also ok to apply the 45-day trial extension.

I'll set the internal test ticket and mark this as medium priority. Marissa — if you can confirm, I'll action the sandbox top-up and send the calendar invite to Arcadia.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_se_note.txt (text/plain)]
